newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal may permit commercial paper in repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal may permit commercial paper in repos.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal is studying allowing commercial paper to be used as a guarantee in repo operations, the vice-governor of the central bank Abel Mateus said.

He told reporters that a previously announced decision to allow private debt to be used as a guarantee in repo transactions was in line with procedures that will be adopted by the proposed European Central Bank.
He added that these measures would encourage participants and issues to seek ratings.

"If two companies go to the market on the same day to place bonds, a bank would be more interested in a company that has a rating, bceause it could use that paper to take part in repo operations with the Bank of Portugal," said Silvino Paiva Lopes, director of the credit operations department of the Bank of Portugal.
